  <div class="editorial-grid">
    <h2>Two days of Bayesian research and exchange.</h2>
    <div class="prose-large">
      <p>The II International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics was held on 4–5 June 2026 at CUNEF Universidad in Madrid, following the first edition in 2024.</p>
      <p>The single-track meeting combined seven keynote talks with contributed sessions, including work by early-career researchers. Registration was free thanks to support from SEIO and CUNEF Universidad.</p>
